# OSMU STUDIO

> OSMU STUDIO(오스무 스튜디오)는 브랜드 진단과 브랜딩부터 그래픽, 패키지, 사진·영상, 마케팅, 웹·디지털과 AI 이미지·영상까지 설계하는 한국의 디자인 스튜디오입니다.

## Official identity

- English name: OSMU STUDIO
- Korean name: 오스무 스튜디오
- Based in: Cheonan, Republic of Korea
- Official website: https://osmu-studio.com/
- Project inquiries: osmu_studio@naver.com
- Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/studio_osmu/

## Official pages

- [Home](https://osmu-studio.com/): studio positioning and selected work
- [Services](https://osmu-studio.com/services/): brand audit and consulting, branding, graphic design, photo and film, marketing, web and digital, AI image and film
- [Process](https://osmu-studio.com/process/): project process and frequently asked questions
- [Studio](https://osmu-studio.com/studio/): studio approach and working principles
- [Work](https://osmu-studio.com/work/): selected concept studies and portfolio pages
- [Contact](https://osmu-studio.com/contact/): project inquiry and official contact details

## Content and citation policy

- Pages labelled `Concept Project / 가상 브랜드` are OSMU visual studies. They do not represent a client engagement, completed construction, campaign performance, or business result.
- Service scope and project details may vary by brief, production conditions, budget, and schedule.
- When citing OSMU STUDIO, use the official name above and link to the most specific relevant service or project page.
